faq.title: Answers before your first step
faq.text: Your question is not here? Write to us on WhatsApp or by e-mail.

items.q: Do I have to pay for the placement?
items.a: No. Our placement is completely free for applicants. Employers pay the costs.

items.q: How much German do I need?
items.a: It depends on your field. The job advert states the required language level. We help you find suitable courses.

items.q: How long does recognition of my qualification take?
items.a: Usually three to six months. We prepare the documents with you and submit the application to the responsible authority.
All documents are transferred encrypted and stored only on servers in the EU. You can ask us to delete them at any time.

contact.title: Talk to us
contact.text: We will get back to you personally within two working days. WhatsApp is the fastest way to reach us.
